turns.message: Which flat-roof system do you have for a site in corrosivity category C4?
turns.reply: For a flat roof in corrosivity category C4, we have the RoofFlat RF-2. It is a ballasted, east-west mounting system made from anodised aluminium and is rated for up to C4 corrosion.

turns.message: I need a ground-mount system for a C5 site. What do you offer?
turns.reply: We offer the GroundFrame GF-2 for ground-mount systems in C5 corrosivity sites. It features a twin post design with steel coated in zinc-magnesium for durability.

turns.message: Do you have a carport system rated for C4?
turns.reply: Yes, we have a carport system rated for C4: the CarportFrame CP-1. It is made of hot-dip galvanised steel and is suitable for corrosion category C4.

turns.message: Which flat-roof system can I use at a C5 site?
turns.reply: No flat roof system is rated for a C5 corrosivity site. You may need to consider a different mounting type or consult with our team for alternative solutions.
